# `array_prepend`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Add the element at the beginning of the array passed as first
argument. Type of element should be the same as the type of the elements of the array.
Null element is also prepended to the array. But if the array passed is NULL
output is NULL

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
array_prepend(array, element)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `array_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- array_prepend, example 1
> SELECT array_prepend(array('b', 'd', 'c', 'a'), 'd');
["d","b","d","c","a"]
```

```sql
-- array_prepend, example 2
> SELECT array_prepend(array(1, 2, 3, null), null);
[null,1,2,3,null]
```

```sql
-- array_prepend, example 3
> SELECT array_prepend(CAST(null as Array<Int>), 2);
NULL
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.5.0.
